title: Retail / Checkout zone presence - sanity pack (reduced scope)
purpose: M0 sanity scenario, updated at M1. One real retail clip, one pinned detector, the annotated detection fixture, and the clips a presenter can switch between. M1 delivered the ROI geometry and event state machine: app/engine/retail_config.py ships COUNTER_BAND and a people-in-zone presence event. NO product-transfer event is detectable on this footage - the only reliably tracked product is stationary in the basket for the entire clip.

event_annotations.measured: 2 events over the clip = two sustained presences, one per person-track; NOT a people count and NOT a dwell measurement, as the event carries no duration

content_gate.spec_requirement: three 45-90 second clips per scenario pack
content_gate.note: Clip count for this pack is met at three; the duration band is not. Only store_aisle_alt (65.41535 s) lies inside 45-90 s. retail_checkout (113.0129 s) and queue_alt (139.4 s) are longer than the band. Durations are cv2.VideoCapture measurements of the copied files, not rounded or trimmed. Carried to Task 9 as a declared unmet gate.

business_line: People present at the checkout counter
business_metric: Counted sustained presences at the checkout counter, one per person track
explanation: Measured: zone_occupancy - each tracked person whose box centre stays inside counter_band (x 0.00-1.00, y 0.20-0.60) for at least 2.0 s. The event is a presence, one per continuous stay and one per track; it carries no duration, so it is NOT a dwell measurement and NOT a people count. The specification's product-transfer rule is NOT computed: no product-transfer event is detectable on retail_checkout. The other three clips are a content assignment, not a proven scene fit; bottle-detection may legitimately produce zero events because the tracked class is person.
scope_note: REDUCED SCOPE. No product-transfer event is detectable on retail_checkout: the clip contains no shelf, and the only sustained movement is a person at the counter. Shelf-to-basket is NOT delivered. The counter surface is labelled 17 different ways and its label changes on 12.7% of adjacent frame pairs; it is excluded from tracked_classes. COUNTER_BAND captures 65% of person detections, not all of them. See app/engine/retail_config.py.
content_assignment: Clip-to-pack assignment is by content, not a proven scene fit: all four clips show retail-like people or products, but only retail-checkout was measured for the counter_band geometry.

zones.name: counter_band
zones.measured: Derived from a measured person-centroid histogram on retail_checkout: 3512 of 5393 person detections (65.1%) have their centre inside; the two dominant person tracks are 100% inside (470 and 2920 observations, centroid y 0.237..0.500). Full containment is never true for a person in this clip, which is why the rule tests the centre.

delivered_event: Delivered event: people-in-zone presence, 2 events per clip. NOT a people count. NOT a dwell measurement.
